name: labs/sqlim__sr860-python
title: Stanford Research Systems SR860 DSP lock-in amplifier
intro: Stanford Research Systems SR860 DSP lock-in amplifier, adapted from sqlim/sr860-python. It reads `time_constant_index`, `x`, `y`, `r` and 1 more; sets `frequency`, `amplitude`, `phase`, `dc_offset` and 10 more. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/sqlim__sr860-python --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/sqlim__sr860-python --backend fake --mcp
